name: Swaple Medicine
source:
Jin Kiryu yearned for a girl. That girl was the fiance of his younger brother.
He put a devious plan into motion involving an aphrodisiac and swinging couples.
Four bodies, two pairs of swapped lovers...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE079161.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
桐生仁渴望着一个女孩，而那个女孩正是他弟弟的未婚妻。
他实施了一个围绕媚药与交换伴侣展开的阴险计划。
四具身体，两对交换了的恋人……
